title: Reproduce: G(3,9) = 49 (the 2007 table prints 48)
statement: There is no set of 49 integers whose consecutive gaps are all at most 9 and which contains no three terms in arithmetic progression. (A 48-element set exists, so this is G(3,9) = 49; three independent searches inside this project agree, and this unit asks for confirmation from outside it.)

inputs.expected_cost: about 1 CPU-hour growing the set outward from its middle; a few CPU-hours for plain backtracking in C
